name: Shimojou Kazuma
source: The protagonist. He is perverted, stupid, and has a strong sense of justice and libido. Now a second year student attending Toaru Girl's Academy because his [url=/c85777]sister's[/url]  fulfillment skill awakened a power in him. He is regarded as talented, and while he does attend the super power school, he has never been able to use his powers since enrollment and is in danger of failing. He is a boob lover that is faithful to his lust. His younger sister will enroll in the school next year and is currently a manga artist for a doujin circle.
